rule_based_signals: predictive word used as a verb
distribution_scope: Combined validation and test annotated rows only.
processing_scope: Pre-split validation and test files are supplied directly; no splitting is done in this script. The same spaCy pipeline is loaded once and applied separately to the validation and test files. Benchmark metrics compare each held-out split against the supplied Ground Truth labels. No manual labeling, classifier training, classifier selection, classifier application, or classifier-specific FLS datasets are produced.
